behaviors_asserted: Currently, when creating routes with validators in Hono, have to manually define a TypeScript type for the Context in order to use it inside controllers.
Provide a way to automatically access the Context type for each chained route directly from Hono.
Provide a utility or helper type that infers the final Context type of a route after validators/middlewares have been applied.
Expose something like RouteGetContext<typeof statusRoutes["get"]> or similar.
